page_title: RSO 0-0 BET | Real Sociedad v Betis 17/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' A player from Betis pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
90+2' Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows the whistle, Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) is penalised for a foul.
90+2' The resulting corner from Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is cleared.
90+2' The ball is cleared after Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.

89' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Rui Silva leaps like a salmon to deny him.
87' Isco (Betis) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
87' Isco (Betis) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
86' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets Ferrer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
85' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
84' Substitution. Kieran Tierney leaves the pitch and is replaced by Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad).
84' Imanol Alguacil has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) replacing Mikel Merino.
82' Rodri (Betis) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
82' Betis failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

82' He should have scored! Rodri (Betis) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. The ball goes out of play. Betis are awarded a corner kick.
81' Jon Magunazelaia Argoitia (Real Sociedad) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Betis are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
78' Ayoze Perez (Betis) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer had an easy-decision to make.
75' That's the end of the game for Mikel Oyarzabal, who is replaced by Jon Magunazelaia Argoitia (Real Sociedad).
75' Assane Diao (Betis) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
74' The attendance for today's match is 33172.
74' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
73' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. William Carvalho (Betis) replaces Sergi Altimira.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Abde Ezzalzouli trots off the pitch and is replaced by Rodri (Betis).

69' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
68' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
66' Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle and it's Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
65' Isco sends in a poor cross from the corner and Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) has no trouble gathering it.

64' Marc Roca (Betis) won himself some space after the corner kick and tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box. His effort is directed to the top left corner, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes the save. Betis force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
64' Isco (Betis) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
64' Isco (Betis) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Betis force a corner. They send men into the box.
63' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Isco (Betis) took the corner.
63' Abner (Betis) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball is out of play. Betis win a corner kick.
62' A clumsy foul by Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle.
60' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
60' Isco (Betis) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and Betis manage to earn a corner.
59' Substitution. Willian Jose will be replaced by Assane Diao (Betis).
59' Imanol Alguacil decides to make a substitution. Arsen Zakharyan will be replaced by Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad).
58' We are about to witness a substitution. Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) is replacing Andre Silva.

57' The ball rebounds to Aitor Ruibal (Betis) and he shoots from distance, but the keeper calmly watches it drift well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
57' Betis can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
57' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Isco (Betis). Betis earn a corner.
54' Mateo Busquets Ferrer interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Andre Silva (Real Sociedad).
54' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 7:4.
49' OFF THE POST! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) produces a stunning shot towards goal from the free kick, but the ball rattles the right post.
49' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
47' Chadi Riad (Betis) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Real Sociedad will take a free kick near the side line.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' Sergi Altimira (Betis) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Real Sociedad have a free kick.
43' Mateo Busquets Ferrer shows a yellow card to Marc Roca (Betis) for his blatant foul.
43' One of the Real Sociedad players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. It's a free kick to Betis, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
41' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Andre Silva (Real Sociedad) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.

40' Ayoze Perez (Betis) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and shoots at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort only hits the right-hand post! The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
35' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.

34' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) latches on to a pin-point pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a daisy-cutter shot towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper produces an amazing acrobatic dive to deny him. The ball bounces off his gloves and hits the post. The ball goes out for a corner. Real Sociedad can continue in their attacking effort.
32' Abner (Betis) is penalised for holding. Mateo Busquets Ferrer signals a set piece. Real Sociedad are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
30' Willian Jose (Betis) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance! The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
29' A player from Betis takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Real Sociedad have been awarded a free kick.
27' A goal, which was scored by Andre Silva (Real Sociedad), was disallowed due to offside.
24' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Aitor Ruibal (Betis) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
22' Betis take a short corner kick.

21' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) picks up the rebound just outside the box and releases a weak low shot that heads towards the left post, but it fails to give the goalkeeper anything to worry about. Corner kick. Betis will have an opportunity.
17' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Rui Silva is equal to it and makes an easy save.
16' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
13' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
13' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

8' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
6' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. It's a free kick to Betis in a dangerous position.
4' Betis control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Betis will take the kick-off.
Mateo Busquets Ferrer is the one to supervise the game today.
